purpose: official Wintun binary archive and license review; no native acceptance

review.method: Read the retained Actions archive/license and verify its published archive SHA256 and per-entry hashes. No local driver load, native experiment, compilation or project test was performed.
review.distribution_condition: Section 3(d) permits redistribution alongside other software that uses the Software only via the Permitted API (the distributed wintun.h API interfaces). Preserve all proprietary notices and do not modify/reverse engineer the DLL. This is the exact binary-distribution license, separate from the GPL-2.0 upstream source license.
review.adapter_boundary: Unmodified signed DLL through the selected maintained tun-rs provider; NestLink adds only local principal/pipe/OS-resource lifecycle and uses native Windows IP Helper for exact product configuration. No Wintun source or ring implementation is copied.

authenticode.reason: The first hosted fixture's Windows PowerShell 5.1 inherited a PowerShell 7 module path and could not load the inbox security module. Source now selects the absolute inbox executable and inbox module path; a later exact-source Actions run must prove Valid/WireGuard LLC.
